                           POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE # 9/94



  TO:             Distribution

  FROM:           Richard C. Visconti, R.A
                  First Deputy Commission

  DATE:           August 8, 1994

  SUBJECT:        Individualized Residential Alternative (IRA) Facilities



  EFFECTIVE: Immediately

  BACKGROUND:

        The State of New York Office of Mental Retardation & Development Disabilities (OMRDD),
 pursuant to Title 14 NYCRR Part 686.16 shall certify the facility class known as Individual
 Residential Alternative (IRA). A facility in this class for eight or fewer persons, shall meet the
 Building Code for New York City in Section 635-7.1 (a)(9)(i)(b) of this title.

 PURPOSE:

        To establish uniform guidelines for accepting applications for an IRA facility.

 SPECIFICS:

         An IRA facility shall be classified as a 1-3 occupancy if located in a one or two-family
 dwelling, and a 1-2 occupancy, if located in a multiple dwelling. OMRDD shall provide a letter
 identifying the facility as an IRA and indicate that fire safety evacuation needs have been reviewed
 by OMRDD pursuant to applicable State Regulations. A sample of such letter is attached.
                                                2



       The application shall be reviewed pursuant to the applicable J-3 (for one or two family
dwellings only, not for group homes) or J-2 Occupancy Classification of the new Building Code, and
a permit shall be issued accordingly.

       The following memoranda and interpretations are not applicable to IRA facilities:

       1       Community Residences for Mentally Disabled, dated July 16, 1987.
       2.      Community Residences, dated July 14, 1981.
       3.      Community Residences for the Mentally Disabled, dated March 10, 1980.
       4.      Community Residences, dated January 8, 1980.
       5.      Group Homes, dated December 17, 1975.
       6.      Group Homes, dated April 4, 1975.

        Certificates of Occupancy that are issued relative to such program will note that "This
residence is a New York State certified Individualized Residential Alternative for eight or fewer
persons pursuant to Title 14 NYCRR Part 686.16. Persons admitted to this facility have had their
safety evacuation needs assessed and that the IRA has implemented a facility evacuation plan. The
Office of Mental Retardation and Development Disabilities shall issue a written notice to the New
York City Department of Buildings, if and when this IRA Program is decertified by OMRDD and its
license revoked."

      The license for the IRA must be received prior to the issuance of a Final Certificate of
Occupancy.
